description: Changes a message's state via Gmail labels: read=true/false marks read/unread, starred=true/false stars/unstars, archived=true removes it from the inbox (archived=false moves it back), and add_label_ids/remove_label_ids apply or strip any labels from list_labels (e.g. a user label, or IMPORTANT). At least one change is required; applying the same change twice is harmless. This never deletes anything — use manage_trash for the trash. Returns the message's new id/labelIds.

items.description: A label id from list_labels — system ids like "INBOX", "UNREAD", "STARRED", "SPAM", "TRASH" or a user label id like "Label_123".

archived.description: true = archive (remove from inbox), false = move back to inbox.

message_id.description: The message id from list_messages/get_thread output (not the RFC Message-ID header).

read.description: true = mark read, false = mark unread.

items.description: A label id from list_labels — system ids like "INBOX", "UNREAD", "STARRED", "SPAM", "TRASH" or a user label id like "Label_123".

name: modify_message
title: Change message labels / state
